usedFor: Text-Em-All holds your text messaging history, and Google Docs records incoming replies through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Text Received” in Text-Em-All, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Every reply you receive is written to a doc, so replies sit in one readable place.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite a tab, so choose add to keep earlier replies.
